name: gas-city-workflow
description: Transactional Beads-first lifecycle orchestration for Gas City projects and read-only reviewers.

interface.shortDescription: Orient and work safely in Gas City projects
interface.longDescription: Gas City Workflow provides a deterministic project-context capsule plus journaled begin, resume, recover, checkpoint, verify, publish, and finish transitions. It keeps Beads authoritative, preserves Aegis evidence, and applies the same lifecycle across Gas City, HPFetcher, Blog, and descriptor-based future projects without granting new permissions.
defaultPrompt: Begin or resume this Gas City bead through the journaled project workflow
Inspect the current bead, plan, session, journal, and next safe workflow step
